body.name: Gaussian bipartite witness \(\mathfrak F_n\)
body.construction: For each \(n\ge4\), let \(G=I_n\), let independent \(E_i\sim N(0,1)\) satisfy \(Z_1=E_1\), \(Z_2=E_2\), \(Z_3=Z_1+Z_2+E_3\), \(Z_4=Z_1+(1+2^{-n})Z_2+E_4\), and \(Z_j=E_j\) for \(j\ge5\). In intervention \(i\), replace the equation for \(Z_i\) by an independent \(N(0,2)\) draw and leave all other mechanisms fixed.
